ModMetaData.name: Gesvd’s RimLingo: a runtime translator for RimWorld
ModMetaData.author: Gesvd & Codex
ModMetaData.description:
Gesvd的边缘翻译：RimWorld 游戏内模组翻译器。内置官方简体中文界面，支持离线翻译、API 翻译、词汇统一及手动修正。
Translate loaded RimWorld mods during runtime from an in-game settings panel.
The mod does not connect to any translation service during game startup. Players choose which loaded mods to translate, select a provider and target language, then start or pause translation manually.
